pr_body:
**What type of PR is this?**
/kind feature

**What this PR does / why we need it**:
We need a mechanism to support the deprecated metrics unit test, especially for the packages out of `component-base`.

Since we can't get build-in versions in unit tests, so we need a fake method to create a registry with an individual version. 

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:
Fixes #86292

**Special notes for your reviewer**:

**Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?**:
```release-note
NONE
```

**Additional documentation e.g., KEPs (Kubernetes Enhancement Proposals), usage docs, etc.**:

/priority backlog
/milestone v1.18

issue_context.title: Provide a  mechanism to support deprecated metrics testing
issue_context.body:
**What would you like to be added**:
Once a metric be deprecated, we should update the unit test accordingly if there is any.
We need to work out a way for a unit test freely select codebase version, and also should make sure the unit test won't fail in the subsequent release.

**Why is this needed**:
Deprecated also needs to be protected.

/sig instrumentation
/assign

review_comments: Do we want more assertions for the fake registry?

Not so much necessary. Added a basic test.
Done.
